notes:
New
• Style Inspiration: give Solis a video to edit like (upload it, or paste a YouTube link). It studies the pacing, cuts, zooms, sound effects, music and transitions, shows what it learned, and edits your
• Competition Intro now edits from a reference grammar learned from your own edit: every sound, zoom and music choice has a reason you can read
• Revisions use your Premiere playhead: "remove that sound effect", "remove this zoom" and "make this full facecam" target what you're looking at
• "Change the music" (or "use a scarier song") swaps the track for that section

Fixed
• "Remove that sound effect" removed every sound effect; now it removes one, and only "remove all sound effects" removes them all
• Music volume requests ("music is too loud", "I can't hear the music", "lower all music") are understood, and only the music where you are changes unless you say "all"
• The same sound effect (like the sliding sound) no longer repeats back to back; sounds only play on real moments, and fewer sounds are used
• Revisions no longer change clips, zooms and sounds you didn't ask about, and a revision is only marked applied when Premiere shows the change
• Pauses kept as "reactions" with nothing happening in them are now cut
• Captions on the timeline: the Premiere template path was wrong, so captions fell back to a file

Testing
• Competition Intro quality is being tuned against your own reference edit; tell us with Send Feedback what looks or sounds wrong
• YouTube links give a partial style match; upload the video for the full one
